findings.title: A failed native runtime close permanently blocked public cleanup retry
findings.mechanism: _start_owned_close previously returned whenever _close_task existed, including a definitively failed task. If session.aclose raised once, _close_owned drained independent owners and raised NativeCleanupIncomplete, but every later public aclose only observed the cached failure. The application could not retry the retained SDK resource through the public lifecycle API.

evidence.claim: Owned-close task sharing and failed-task retry decision.
Public close fences admission and shields the actual owned close task.
SDK close failure is sanitized while independent cleanup continues.
Existing close-failure regression formerly required private _close_task=None repair; now exercises public retry.

reproducible_schedule: Start the genuine pinned AgentSession with synthetic local STT/LLM/TTS and hold an intake plus observer.
Inject one session.aclose exception; release independent work and observe sanitized NativeCleanupIncomplete with sdk_closed false.
Restore the SDK close implementation and call public runtime.aclose. Before the fix the SDK close is never entered; a bounded regression fails waiting for that entry.

After the fix, hold the new SDK close, start a second public close waiter, cancel the first waiter, and verify only one actual retry remains owned. Release it and observe sdk_closed true and successful subsequent close.
findings.test_weakness_corrected: The old assertion proved independent drains and safe diagnostics but repaired a private field in teardown, masking lack of public retry. The replacement checks retry entry, concurrent sharing, continued admission fencing, cancellation of one waiter without cancellation of the actual owner, eventual SDK closure and reuse of successful close.
findings.change: Only a definitively failed/cancelled cached task may be replaced. Pending and successful close tasks remain shared; the new task still uses eager_start=False and public waiters remain shielded.
findings.limitations: The regression injects a transient exception before genuine SDK closure and proves retry ownership. It does not certify recovery from every possible internal SDK failure or browser transport failure.

followup_review_items.title: Response-view reads do not explicitly stop at runtime close

evidence.claim: communication_view delegates when capture is configured without its own _closed check.
Manager view validates retained response membership then starts a publication without checking closed.
Manager aclose stops and drains current publications/reports.

followup_review_items.possible_schedule: An application calls communication_view after runtime.aclose has completed while its separately owned communication port is still open; the retained response can initiate another read. This could race the application closing that port.
followup_review_items.why_not_promoted: No end-to-end reproduction or explicit documented post-close read contract was completed in this pass. Application wrappers may already fence the method. This read does not itself grant business authority or create durable accepted work.
followup_review_items.recommended_next_step: Clarify whether post-close evidence reads are deliberately supported. Otherwise add closed admission at the public read boundary and a narrow test proving no port invocation after close.

academy_comparison.extent: Relevant public text/code passages and retained course review, not a claim of completing video lessons or all Academy exercises during this code pass.

intentional_divergences.assessment: P2 deliberately replaces automatic lk.chat consumption with authenticated bounded intake and durable dispatch. Tutorial direct-to-LLM flow is appropriate for a transient conversation but cannot replace this selected persist-before-generation contract.

Pinned hook takes ChatContext and new ChatMessage. Its default body is a no-op; omitting an alleged Agent.default hook call does not block automatic generation. P2 correctly raises StopResponse and has a positive-control real SDK test.

P2 registers Python methods on room.local_participant and checks caller_identity against the trusted binding. An SDK event handler or request body label is not an authorization or durable business receipt.

P2 uses the supported full llm_node signature and typed ChoiceDelta content. It preserves streaming with bounds rather than buffering arbitrary model JSON or treating model fields as mutation authority.
Push-to-talk/manual turn control is intentional. It does not claim adaptive VAD/barge-in tuning. An interruption request, SDK settlement, generated text and browser playback remain distinct facts.
SIP, warm transfers, avatars, robotics and vector RAG are not P2 V1 requirements. No absent Academy feature is labelled a defect or silently added.
